newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares rise further in buoyant market.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares rise further in buoyant market.

text.p: Trading in Estonian shares was brisk on Wednesday, with the market rising further and leading bank Hansapank the most traded share, dealers said.

The official list volume came to 39.3 million kroons, with the index rising by 2.8 percent to 155.1. Shares in Hansapank turned over 15 million kroons and closed higher at 158.10 kroons versus 155.50.
"Smaller investors showed deep interest in Hansapank and the buying side dominated," said one dealer.
Forekspank was also active on trade of 7.3 million kroons and it ended higher at 112.80 kroons versus 107.40.
Estonia's second largest bank Savings Bank had volume of 5.6 million kroons, but closed slightly lower at 66 kroons versus 66.50.
Tallinna Pank saw trade of 5.5 million kroons and closed lower at 56.35 kroons versus 57.05.
The over-the-counter market volume was 4.7 million kroons and Rakvere meat processing company was the most traded. It closed unchanged at nine kroons.
